name: Summer Festival
steps: Drag the broom across the ground to sweep away trash and clean the festival path.
Drag the wooden skewer to the cotton candy machine to spin fresh pink cotton candy.
Light the fireworks launcher boxes in the background to shoot colorful fireworks into the night sky.
Hand the toy superhero mask and prop to the little boy by the stall.
Dress both girls in traditional yukatas, and use the paper net scoop to catch the goldfish into the bowl.
